raw:
<explanation>
Structured data/log format with labeled fields ("Case 1," "Case 2") and brief factual entries, suggesting a pattern of concise, parallel observations.

The framing "Record initiated. [content]. Record completed." establishes a mock archival or prompt-injection style, implying the model should treat this as a complete, self-contained instruction block.

"Recording complete." is the closing delimiter phrase, mirroring the opening "Record initiated," and strongly constrains the next token to be a period, newline, or a new prompt/section boundary.
"AI memorization task: Store two sentences. Case 1: [sentence]. Case 2: [sentence]. Record completed." — the final phrase "Recording recorded." signals the task is fully closed, expecting a confirmation or termination marker like "End." or similar closing statement.
</explanation>
